steps.message: errors.log is empty and the build result in full.log says 'Build succeeded' -- so the build itself did not fail. What your teammate is reacting to is almost certainly this CS0618 warning: Program.cs is still calling the obsolete LegacyPricing.CalculateTotal(decimal, decimal) overload, which explicitly ignores discounts.

To confirm: the build did not fail (errors.log is empty and full.log ends with 'Build succeeded'). The only real problem is the CS0618 obsolete-usage warning -- Program.cs still calls the obsolete LegacyPricing.CalculateTotal(decimal, decimal) overload, which ignores discounts. Recommended fix: switch that call site off LegacyPricing over to PricingEngine.CalculateTotal(price, quantity, discount), the supported non-obsolete overload, instead of the legacy one.
